description: Fictional Mode A/Mode C interrogation and decoded reply records. This starts at decoded receiver output, not RF waveforms or pulse decoding. The derived report is an exact qualified selection of a retained decoded reply.

synthesis.schedule: Sixteen4-second cycles. Four0.5-second interrogations start at offsets0,0.8,1.6,2.4 seconds; the first pair points30 degrees,the second330 degrees, each50 degrees wide. Each pair is Mode A then Mode C. Authored reply time=start+0.3 s,available time=reply time+0.08 s. The timing is a reduced example, not a protocol latency claim.
synthesis.targetModel: Cooperative A:E=1200+18t,N=3400-8t,up1400 m,code0421,reported pressure altitude4600 ft. Cooperative B:E=-1500+11t,N=2700+5t,up2100 m,code6312,reported pressure altitude6800 ft. Unreplied scene:E=250+5t,N=2200+4t,up900 m,transponder disabled. Geometric up and reported pressure altitude are independent authored quantities.
synthesis.sampling: A transponder replies only when inside the current authored azimuth beam. Slant range is sqrt(E²+N²+up²) plus uniform±12 m; bearing plus uniform±0.12 degrees. No elevation response, horizon, terrain, propagation, multipath, mode interlace decoding or receiver RF simulation.
synthesis.dropout: A has no retained replies during cycles6–8; B during cycle10. Absence is represented by no decoded reply for an interrogation, never a synthetic zero range or altitude.
synthesis.garble: B has invalid decoded rows during cycle4. Every measurement/code/altitude is blank in those rows; invalid data remains inspectable and is not promoted into a usable report.
synthesis.unavailableAltitude: B Mode C rows during cycles11–12 have retained range/bearing but blank pressure altitude. Blank means not recorded. It is not zero altitude, geometric height or a negative observation.
synthesis.truth: Separate scenario positions and authored transponder state. The source without replies is visible only when explicitly inspecting generator truth; it does not appear as a sensor-reported aircraft.

reports.selection: One derived report per valid decoded reply, with report_id added and all retained fields copied exactly. The referenced interrogation must exist. Invalid replies are excluded without erasing them from the raw table.
reports.identity: Four-digit octal Mode A code is a reported transponder code. It is not aircraft identity, verified ownership, military classification or friend-or-foe authentication. Mode A and Mode C rows are not fused or associated into an aircraft track.
reports.altitude: Mode C pressure altitude uses1013.25 hPa reference and100 ft increments. No conversion to geometric elevation, terrain clearance or horizontal ground range is performed.
reports.display: Polar slant range and bearing. Do not treat the radial distance as horizontal range or place reports on an east/north ground map.
reports.availability: Explicit available_s controls report visibility. A valid row with unknown altitude remains a usable range/bearing report. A no-reply interval supports only the statement that no reply was retained.

exclusions: No physical radar calibration or RF pulse decoder
No operational protocol timing or hardware sensitivity claim
No primary radar returns or inferred detection of the source with no reply
No transponder identity verification, Mode S address, IFF or aircraft authentication
No geometric-height conversion, target tracking or fusion across modes
No calibrated false-reply probability or uncertainty ellipse
